subject: Kickoff: ClearFin workspace onboard sync & API credential plan
messages:
From: Sara Blake <sara@clearfin.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-11-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: ClearFin kickoff & API credential request

Vanessa / Redwood team — thanks again for the demo yesterday. We’re ready to start the workspace provisioning next week and want to align on the minimum set of items to unblock our engineers. High-level asks from our side:

- A seeded admin API key and a project namespace we can use for initial integration (non-production).
- Invite flow for 3 admin users + 6 developer seats; ability to scope roles to projects.
- Guidance on SSO (SAML) timeline — we expect to enable via Okta within the first sprint.
- Any required information for KMS/HSM integration and audit log exports (we have SOC 2 audits coming).

Can you confirm who internally will own the handoff and what the proposed timeline is? We’d like a short mutual action plan and a kickoff slot next Tue or Wed (US morning). I’ve attached a short internal checklist for context.

Attachments: clearfin-internal-priorities.pdf (stub)

Best,
Sara Blake
Head of Platform Engineering
ClearFin Labs
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: Sara Blake <sara@clearfin.ai>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-11-02T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ClearFin kickoff & API credential request

Sara — thanks for the clear list. TL;DR: we can seed a scoped admin API key (non-prod) and create the project namespace before your engineers start. Monica will lead the CS handoff; Karthik + Marcus will own the implementation details. Proposed next steps below and a couple of clarifying Qs.

Proposed immediate plan:
1) Kickoff meeting: Wed 2028-11-08, 10:30–11:00 PT (we’ll confirm if that works for your team).
2) Pre-kickoff deliverables (due Mon 2028-11-06): Redwood creates the non-prod project namespace and seeds one admin API key with limited TTL; we upload the invite list and initial role template.
3) Sprint 0 (first week): SSO enablement + API integration test, rotate scoped keys to your KMS once SSO confirmed.

Clarifying Qs:
- Do you want the seeded admin key to be time-limited (we default to 7 days for seeded keys) or persistent until you rotate it to KMS?
- For the invite list, will the 3 admins include procurement/legal contacts or strictly engineers?

I’ll attach our onboarding MOP and a short checklist to the kickoff invite. Monica — can you prepare the mutual action plan template and list of role templates we typically use? Karthik/Marcus — please review SSO/KMS notes below and flag anything we should pre-provision.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
From: monica_patel@redwood.ai
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, Sara Blake <sara@clearfin.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-11-02T10:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ClearFin kickoff & API credential request

Sara / team — I’ll own the mutual action plan and CS-led onboarding sequence. Draft plan summary below (will turn into a shared doc ahead of kickoff):

Mutual Action Plan (draft)
- Pre-kickoff (by 2028-11-06): Redwood creates workspace 'clearfin-nonprod', seeds 1 admin API key (7d TTL unless you confirm otherwise), uploads role templates (Admin / Project-Admin / Developer / Billing-Observer).
- Kickoff (2028-11-08): walk through roles, invite flow, API smoke test.
- Week 1 (2028-11-08 to 2028-11-15): SSO discovery & test account setup (Okta), API integration (POST /v1/generate + embeddings smoke tests), KV/prefix caching guidance for developer flows.
- Week 2: KMS handoff (we provide key wrap guidance), production workspace provisioning plan, and runbook for rotates and emergency access.

Deliverables we’ll upload to the shared Drive before kickoff: onboarding-MOP-v1 (attached), project-role-matrix.csv, token-rotation-guide.md.

On your questions: we recommend seeded keys be TTL-limited (7 days) and rotated to your KMS in Week 2; admins should be engineers + 1 IT/Security contact. If procurement/legal need visibility, we can include them in Billing-Observer role.

I’ve attached the MOP and a quick invite template. Van — can you confirm the attendee list and who should get admin invites?

Cheers,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: onboarding-MOP-v1.pdf (stub), project-role-matrix.csv (stub)
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai, Sara Blake <sara@clearfin.ai>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-11-02T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ClearFin kickoff & API credential request

Sara — quick technical notes to help your engineers prepare before kickoff:

1) Namespace and projects: we can pre-create 'clearfin-nonprod' and two projects inside it: 'integration' and 'qa'. Projects map to role-scopes; we'll provide a sample policy you can import.
2) Seeded API key: default TTL 7 days. If you need longer during the POC, we can extend to 30 days but we highly recommend rotating into your KMS ASAP. When you’re ready to rotate, we’ll accept an encrypted wrap key or perform a key-wrapping handshake over our onboarding pipeline.
3) SSO: Redwood supports SAML 2.0 with IdP-initiated and SP-initiated flows. For Okta we need:
   - IdP metadata URL / certificate
   - SCIM token if you want automated user provisioning (optional)
   - Attributes mapping: email, displayName, groups -> project membership

4) Audit logs / SOC 2 needs: we can stream admin/audit events to a customer-owned S3 or to our secure logs export. Please confirm retention window and whether you'd like daily exports.

I attached a lightweight config MOP for SSO and key wrap steps. Marcus — can you confirm whether we should pre-configure SCIM on your tenant or wait until after kickoff?

-Karthik
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachment: sso-kms-mop.pdf (stub)
From: Sara Blake <sara@clearfin.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-11-03T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ClearFin kickoff & API credential request

Team — thanks for the quick turnaround and the clear plan. Confirming items from ClearFin side:

- Kickoff accepted: Wed 2028-11-08, 10:30 PT. Attendees: Sara Blake (Platform), Miguel Torres (Engineer), Priya Desai (IT/Security), Procurement (procurement@clearfin.ai) on the first 15m for purchasing timeline.
- Seeded admin key: 7-day TTL is fine. We’ll rotate to our KMS in Week 2.
- Admin list: Miguel, Priya, and myself. Procurement will be billing-observer.
- SSO: we’ll share Okta metadata and enable SCIM for user provisioning; Miguel will send the metadata by Monday 11/06.
- Audit logs: please stream daily exports to our S3 (s3://clearfin-audit-exports) with a 90-day retention window. Let us know format (JSONL or protobuf) — we prefer JSONL.

Attachments: procurement-PO-request.pdf (stub)

See you on Wednesday — I’ve accepted the calendar invite.

Best,
Sara
